description: Department of Labour - Cost of Living Index for the May 2017 is 122.7 for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades, which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits.
